comment: botl.c eval_notify_windowport_field() (1590) and get_hilite() (2536-2538). The Ranger's 26-byte name is 16 + strlen("Tenderfoot"), so bot_via_windowport() (988-1007) cuts it to BOTL_NSIZ characters and get_hilite()'s txtstr, which skips strlen(svp.plname) + 5 bytes, is empty. The title's val is not empty, so its 'always' rule still colors the title; the alignment rule colors Chaotic as a second field. Seed, clock, name and inputs were chosen independently of every recorded session.
